description: This file contains unit tests for the ZipStream PHP library, specifically testing functionalities related to creating, modifying, and extracting ZIP files, including handling different file encodings, storage methods, large files, and integration with PSR-7 streams.

classes.name: ZipStreamTest
classes.description: Test suite for the ZipStream PHP library, implementing various test cases for zip file creation, modification, encoding, large file handling, and PSR-7 stream integration.

methods.name: testFileNotFoundException
methods.description: Tests that adding a non-existent file throws a FileNotFoundException.

methods.name: testFileNotReadableException
methods.description: Tests that adding a file with no read permissions throws a FileNotReadableException.

methods.name: testDostime
methods.description: Tests the protection method 'dostime' in the File class for correct timestamp conversion.

methods.name: testAddFile
methods.description: Tests adding files directly to the zip archive and verifies extraction correctness.

methods.name: testAddFileUtf8NameComment
methods.description: Tests adding a file with a UTF-8 filename and comment, verifying correct encoding and retrieval.

methods.name: testAddFileUtf8NameNonUtfComment
methods.description: Tests adding a file with a UTF-8 filename and a non-UTF comment, verifying encoding handling.

methods.name: testAddFileNonUtf8NameUtfComment
methods.description: Tests adding a file with a non-UTF8 filename and a UTF-8 comment, verifying encoding handling.

methods.name: testAddFileWithStorageMethod
methods.description: Tests adding files with a specified storage method (store or deflate) and checks that the method is correctly set in the ZIP archive.

methods.name: testDecompressFileWithMacUnarchiver
methods.description: Tests decompressing a ZIP created on macOS using its Archive Utility, verifying files are correctly extracted.

methods.name: testAddFileFromPath
methods.description: Tests adding files from filesystem paths and verifies their content after extraction.

methods.name: testAddFileFromPathWithStorageMethod
methods.description: Tests adding files from paths with specific storage methods and verifies the archive contents.

methods.name: testAddLargeFileFromPath
methods.description: Runs tests for large file additions, with different compression, zip64, zero header options.

methods.name: testAddFileFromStream
methods.description: Tests adding files directly from streams, including using PHP's file streams.

methods.name: testAddFileFromStreamWithStorageMethod
methods.description: Tests adding streams with specific storage methods and verifies their compression methods.

methods.name: testAddFileFromPsr7Stream
methods.description: Tests adding files from PSR-7 streams (Response body in particular).

methods.name: testAddFileFromPsr7StreamWithOutputToPsr7Stream
methods.description: Tests writing ZIP content to a PSR-7 stream and verifies the output files.

methods.name: testAddFileFromPsr7StreamWithFileSizeSet
methods.description: Tests adding PSR-7 streams with a specified file size for correct ZIP entry.

methods.name: testCreateArchiveWithFlushOptionSet
methods.description: Tests that enabling flush output options outputs data immediately and ZIP is correct.

methods.name: testCreateArchiveWithOutputBufferingOffAndFlushOptionSet
methods.description: Tests ZIP creation with output buffering off, then restored after to ensure no output buffering interference.

methods.name: getTmpFileStream
methods.description: Helper method to create a temporary file and stream for testing.

methods.name: validateAndExtractZip
methods.description: Helper method to verify ZIP correctness by extracting to a temporary directory.

methods.name: getTmpDir
methods.description: Helper method to create and return a temporary directory for extraction testing.

methods.name: getRecursiveFileList
methods.description: Recursively lists all files in a directory, used for verifying ZIP extraction content.

methods.name: addLargeFileFileFromPath
methods.description: Helper method to test adding large files from path with various options
